scope: V2 with BF16 expert cache, update 21, rank 0; two owner-selected capacity-check all-reduces.
attribution: CUDA launch ancestry and consumer operations connect both integer-count all-reduces to conditional_capacity_mask and forward dispatch inside compiled backward, consistent with activation recomputation of the capacity path.
limitations: Kernel durations include the lifetime of the NCCL kernel on this rank, potentially waiting for peers; they do not isolate network transfer time.
The two collective durations are not an established recoverable step-time saving.
No code/config changes or runtime experiments performed.

FROM slice d WHERE d.id IN (60411,58892);

selected_launch_ancestors
queries.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE anc AS (
SELECT r.id AS kernel_id,s.id,s.parent_id,s.name,s.category,s.ts,s.dur,s.arg_set_id,0 AS level
FROM rs14_link r JOIN slice s ON s.id=r.host_id WHERE r.id IN (58892,60411)
UNION ALL
SELECT a.kernel_id,s.id,s.parent_id,s.name,s.category,s.ts,s.dur,s.arg_set_id,a.level+1
FROM anc a JOIN slice s ON s.id=a.parent_id WHERE a.level<25)
SELECT kernel_id,id,parent_id,name,category,(ts-3762433098211544)/1e6 AS start_ms,dur/1e6 AS dur_ms,arg_set_id,level FROM anc ORDER BY kernel_id,level;

queries.label: consumer_operations_in_backward_graphs
queries.sql:
WITH g AS (SELECT id,ts,dur,tid FROM thread_slice WHERE id IN (58452,60004))
SELECT g.id AS graph_id,s.id,s.parent_id,s.name,s.category,(s.ts-3762433098211544)/1e6 AS start_ms,s.dur/1e6 AS dur_ms
FROM g JOIN thread_slice s ON s.tid=g.tid AND s.ts>=g.ts AND s.ts<g.ts+g.dur
WHERE s.name GLOB '*capacity*' OR s.name GLOB '*dispatch*' OR s.name GLOB '*is_nonzero*' OR s.name GLOB '*Synchronize*' OR s.name GLOB '*all_reduce*' OR s.name GLOB '*wait_tensor*'
ORDER BY g.id,s.ts LIMIT 100;
